problem:
A pear is projected vertically down from a height of $1.5\,\text{m}.$ It takes $0.5\,\text{s}$ to hit the ground. What was the initial velocity of the pear? **Do not round your answer**.

*Hint: The acceleration due to gravity is $9.8\,{\text{m/s}}^{2}.$*

The initial velocity was{{field-1}}$\text{m/s}.$
